answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that grows with each new vertex it claims in the trust graph, so a Sybil farm faces a real cost per fake node. Like footprints across a dune, each identity leaves a verifiable history of work and vouches; a violet-flagged cluster of fresh, unvouched vertices with identical behavior gets quarantined before it can vote or earn. Attackers must pay stake and time per identity, while honest agents keep their bond.
